name: youtube-comments-api
title: YouTube Comments API - Replies, Likes & Authors
description: Comment scrapers report success on a video whose comments are turned off, so you pay for an empty dataset. This actor reads the watch payload, pages the continuation token and charges only for a comment it delivered.

meta.memoryJustification: The actor reads YouTube's public innertube endpoint over plain HTTP: measured 2026-11-12 it needs no browser, so the run starts at 512 MB, which holds the JSON pages of a comments listing with room to spare.
